question: Should this seven-provider onboarding feature merge without observed after-fix macOS and CLI sign-in evidence?
rationale: The source and automated coverage are strong, but this is a user-visible credential flow across provider, Gateway, protocol, and native-app boundaries; tests alone cannot prove the contributor's real provider and macOS setup.

options.title: Require real flow proof
options.body: Wait for redacted macOS and CLI artifacts showing successful sign-in, cancellation, retry, and copyable errors before merge.

options.title: Accept automated evidence
options.body: Merge based on the reported remote gates and focused tests while explicitly accepting that reviewers have not observed the real provider-auth flow.

recommendation.title: Require real flow proof
recommendation.body: Wait for redacted macOS and CLI artifacts showing successful sign-in, cancellation, retry, and copyable errors before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest current-main history owner for the affected onboarding and Crestodian setup paths and proposed the linked product direction.
